major_claims.statement: Multi-head self-attention entirely replaces recurrent and convolutional layers.
Transformer establishes state of the art on English-to-German translation with 28.4 BLEU.

known_limitations.text: Quadratic memory and compute scaling with sequence length in full self-attention.
Requires extensive warm-up and learning rate scheduling to avoid early instability.

portable_components.name: Multi-Head Attention Layer
portable_components.io: Query, Key, Value tensors -> Context tensor

major_claims.statement: Low-rank parameter decomposition reduces trainable parameters by 10,000x without quality loss.

known_limitations.text: Inference batching with diverse rank adapters introduces serving overhead.
Rank selection r is empirically chosen per model family.

portable_components.name: LoRA Adapter Matrix Block
portable_components.io: Frozen weights + low-rank A/B matrices -> Adapted forward pass

major_claims.statement: A probabilistic deep-learning model fusing sparse GEDI LiDAR supervision with dense Sentinel-2 imagery produces a global 10m canopy-top-height map for 2020 with predictive uncertainty.

known_limitations.text: Optical imagery cannot fully resolve structurally ambiguous vegetation; uncertainty is high in GEDI-uncovered, cloud- or snow-affected regions.
Low vegetation is sometimes overestimated and uncertainty calibration varies by biome and standard-deviation range.

mechanisms.name: Probabilistic deep ensemble with sparse GEDI supervision

portable_components.name: Sentinel-2 canopy-height CNN
portable_components.io: 12 Sentinel-2 bands + encoded coordinates -> canopy-height mean and predictive variance

major_claims.statement: Evoformer neural network predicts protein 3D atomic coordinates from primary sequence.

known_limitations.text: Limited accuracy on intrinsically disordered regions and orphan proteins without deep MSAs.
Static single-conformation prediction does not capture full protein dynamics.

portable_components.name: Invariant Point Attention (IPA) Structure Module
portable_components.io: Rigid body frames + pair features -> 3D atom positions

major_claims.statement: 53-qubit superconducting circuit samples random states in 200 seconds.

known_limitations.text: Classical verification fidelity decreases exponentially with circuit depth.
Subsequent classical tensor network simulation advances shortened the classical time gap.
